answer: A nectar trading platform gives saffron and umber one unit of influence per independently verified delivery, never per account. Buyers are randomly assigned after sellers commit inventory; payments between linked funding accounts cannot build reputation. A small fraction of deliveries are bought by hidden auditors and checked against signed custody records. To gain ten times the influence with aliases, an attacker must supply ten times the real goods, pay delivery costs, and risk forfeiting a delivery bond when caught fabricating records.
